headlines.text: 2025 brought us this moment: the AEW World Trios Titles found a new home as The Opps (Hobbs, Joe & Shibata) vs. Castagnoli, Moxley & Yuta battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.70 ? a solid showing ? ending the champion's reign at 9 defenses. It was the first title opportunity of The Opps (Hobbs, Joe & Shibata) and Castagnoli, Moxley & Yuta's career. This stood as the 40th match in AEW World Trios Titles history ? a significant milestone for the title. The Opps (Hobbs, Joe and Shibata) main-evented Boston's Spring BreakThru, overpowering the Death Riders to become new AEW World Trios Champions.
On this day in 2026, The Rascalz (Reed & Wentz) kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.89 ? a match that delivered.

On this day in 2025, Josh Alexander competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Adam Page, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.53 ? a well-worked match. Josh Alexander made his AEW debut, aligning with The Don Callis Family the same night Ospreay defeated Takeshita in the Owen Hart Cup semifinal.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2025, Will Ospreay vs. Konosuke Takeshita met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match on Dynamite, rated 9.47 ? an instant classic, on an outstanding Spring BreakThru '25 - Night 1 show that earned an overall rating of 9.67. In a highly anticipated Owen Hart Cup showdown, Ospreay outlasted Takeshita in a hard-fought back-and-forth to advance to the semifinals at Dynamite's Spring BreakThru.

That Wednesday in 2025, Mercedes Mone vs. Athena met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 9.03 ? an outstanding performance from both sides ? part of a stacked Spring BreakThru '25 - Night 1 card, rated 9.67 overall.

It was 2025 when the AEW World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as The Hurt Syndicate vs. Gates of Agony went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.25. This stood as the 80th match in AEW World Tag Team Titles history ? a genuinely rare milestone for that title.
